snippet.title: Itochu - Oden and Todo's Fishing Game - 1997
snippet.description:
For those who wants to rememorate this fishing game that was Oden and Todo's Fishing Game (also known as Oden-to todo-no osakanatsuri geimu & おでんととどのお魚釣りゲーム) developed and published by Itochu in 1997.
